title: Video by earn.edits
description:
🎬 Made with Claude. Edited in invideo.

Create motion graphics with Claude Motion, then keep editing them on the same timeline in invideo Editor ⚡ The finished video is only the start. Open the project, change the text, the timing, or a visual, and make it yours 🖥️

🤝 invideo is built for you and your AI to edit together. Direct the work from Claude, then refine the same project by hand.

🔌 Connect it in a few taps: Claude → Settings → Connectors → Discover → invideo → Connect

💬 Comment “INVIDEO” and I’ll send you the connector 🔗

#invideo #ClaudeMotion #AIVideoEditing #MotionGraphics #VideoEditing
